derivation:
by
  exact DFunLike.coe_injective.moduleIsTorsionFree (fun φ : H1 L ⊤ 𝒪 => ⇑φ) (fun _ _ => rfl)
explanation: H1 is an abbreviation for additive homomorphisms into 𝒪. Specialize Mathlib's torsion-freeness pullback theorem to their injective, scalar-preserving coercion into the function module, whose torsion-freeness is supplied by existing instances.
